dramatic_truth: Post-rain inspection converts the Greyfin dispute from a binary safe/failed argument into managed traffic under multiple local failure modes, while Greg treats trial-limb use as optional data rather than a quota.
performance: Greg records condition, repair and traffic authority separately, accepts that fuel, wages and road safety can all be true at once, and uses the trial build only on stable depot gravel when fatigue and surface justify it.
screenplay: Post-rain Section Three and Section One failures; targeted repair; class-seven corridor reopens under inspection; limited fuel crosses; Greg completes contract minimum and makes a bounded depot leg trial.
prose_comparison: Repeated road checks change variables, consequences and authority. They are controlled comparison, not redundant bureaucracy.

dramatic_truth: With the Greyfin minimum complete and a return route available, Greg becomes an ordinary paying passenger because he chooses Merehook instead of being carried there by assignment.
performance: He returns government gear, declines optional extension and Duskport return, prices the next road honestly and lets companions own their own travel decisions.
screenplay: Contract closes; equipment returned; independent passenger seats become the next constraint; Greg chooses the northeast road without quest pressure.
prose_comparison: The logistics matter because this is the first transition from paid route to self-funded continued travel.

dramatic_truth: Fen Crossing makes independent travel concrete by forcing Greg to solve lodging, post, route and companion logistics without a sponsoring institution.
performance: He behaves like a visitor rather than owner, gathers local constraints, preserves his cash floor and keeps moving because he wants the road rather than because somebody needs him.
screenplay: Passenger transfer through Fen Crossing; local stop becomes a lived place; practical arrangements replace assignment coverage; onward Merehook travel remains chosen.
prose_comparison: The mundane stop earns space by changing Greg from contract traveler into self-directed traveler.

dramatic_truth: Merehook immediately asks Greg to mediate between people, information and access rather than solve a technical problem himself.
performance: He carries messages and constraints across social boundaries, resists inflating partial knowledge into expertise and learns that useful intermediary work can be its own role.
screenplay: Arrival friction; Maro returns with a time-sensitive local problem; Greg helps route the right people and information; the city opens through human connection rather than protagonist authority.
prose_comparison: The go-between work advances Greg's emerging intermediary identity and does not repeat prior survey witnessing.

dramatic_truth: Greg experiences Merehook as an onlooker before converting the place into work, property or a problem to solve.
performance: He watches local systems and people operate, lets other characters own their domains and permits curiosity to remain observation.
screenplay: Merehook morning; public systems, birds, local work and access become visible; Greg gathers context without forcing a purchase or intervention.
prose_comparison: The observational density establishes a new city's operating grammar and earns the slower chapter.

dramatic_truth: Staying in Merehook turns curiosity into an explicit economic decision, and Greg prospects for options by ruling bad ones out rather than discovering treasure.
performance: He prices lodging, work, access and possible purchases against his reserve, asks what would actually change his options, and walks away from weak holes.
screenplay: Daily costs become visible; Greg scans work and market opportunities; apparent bargains narrow under evidence; no miracle income appears.
prose_comparison: The list-like prospecting is a decision funnel with eliminations, not shopping repetition.

dramatic_truth: Greg pays the real carrying cost of an auction decision before bidding and separates one next move from a permanent identity or strategy.
performance: He establishes affordability and consequence before entering the room, accepts that choosing to stay is itself a cost and refuses to turn a single decision into destiny.
screenplay: Extra Merehook night purchased; auction access becomes a bounded choice; Greg sets conditions before exposure to bidding pressure.
prose_comparison: Hidden status is publication curation only. The chapter carries the precommitment state that makes the next auction behavior credible.

dramatic_truth: At auction Greg experiences wanting as pressure without allowing the room to rewrite his precommitted value ceilings.
performance: He watches demonstrations, distinguishes useful from merely interesting, bids only inside prior bounds and lets other rational buyers win when price leaves his range.
screenplay: Auction viewing becomes live price discovery; several lots tempt different parts of Greg's systems brain; ceilings hold; losses remain information rather than personal defeat.
prose_comparison: The bidding rhythm is earned suspense because each lot tests a different value rule rather than repeating the same refusal.

dramatic_truth: Companions begin choosing different roads, proving the travel group can separate without betrayal or narrative punishment.
performance: Greg lets Maro leave, treats friendship as compatible with independent direction and keeps his own next route unresolved until it is actually his choice.
screenplay: Maro departs first; companion plans diverge; Greg handles the emotional and logistical separation without manufacturing a breakup scene.
prose_comparison: The quiet departure changes relationship state and makes later solo travel earned.

dramatic_truth: At Lerrin, Greg becomes lookout to a transport and weather system he does not own, using observation without confusing it with navigation authority.
performance: He watches signals, reports what he can actually see and lets route operators decide what those observations mean operationally.
screenplay: Lerrin wakes under changing signal colors; transport/weather constraints sharpen; Greg's role remains bounded observation as routes split again.
prose_comparison: Signal repetition carries changed weather and route state and should not be compressed into generic transit exposition.
